label: First condition of the nervous system - Insight46 phase 2
meta_rows: First condition of the nervous system - Insight46 phase 2

Insight46 phase 2 REM sleep behaviour disorder questionnaire. A yes-no questionnaire, with each "yes" answer worth one point, resulting in a total score beween 0 and 13. A score of 5 or greater is indicative of REM sleep behaviour disorder. Not performed at phase 1.
cat_rows: This category contains questions about activing out dreams (phase 1); several validated sleep questionnaires (phase 2): Epworth Sleepiness Questionnaire, Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), REM Sleep Behaviour Disorder Screening Questionnaire (RBDSQ) of the participants in the Insight46 sub-study.
